IND-BEAUTY-H1: Branding and marketing for skincare brands that refuse to blend in
IND-BEAUTY-HERO-SUB: We make brands impossible to ignore. For indie skincare and beauty founders who are tired of looking like the next brand in the feed.

IND-BEAUTY-BLUR-BODY: Skincare feels crowded to us, and from where we sit a lot of it looks the same. The products can be genuinely good. The trouble is memory: if a shopper can't tell you apart in a fast scroll, your next ad has to start from zero.
IND-BEAUTY-PAIN-1-BODY: Same soft pastels, same clean sans serif, same "clinically proven" claims. When your skincare brand could swap logos with the one in the next ad, customers can't pick you out.
IND-BEAUTY-PAIN-2-BODY: They scroll past your ad, maybe even like it, then can't recall your name a day later. The attention you paid for leaks away because nothing about you is distinctive enough to stick.
IND-BEAUTY-PAIN-3-BODY: Ask an AI assistant for the best moisturiser for sensitive skin and it names your competitors, not you. If AI tools can't work out who you are and what you're known for, they won't recommend you.
IND-BEAUTY-WHAT-H2: What we do for beauty and skincare brands
IND-BEAUTY-WHAT-1-LINE: Identity, positioning and visual systems built to be remembered on screen and in search.
IND-BEAUTY-WHAT-2-LINE: Search engines and AI answers, tuned so your brand shows up where buyers look and ask.
IND-BEAUTY-WHAT-3-LINE: Paid media and testing that connect creative ideas to clear reporting you can act on.
IND-BEAUTY-WHAT-4-LINE: A steady rhythm, platform-native creative and codes people spot in a fast scroll.
IND-BEAUTY-WHAT-PACK: Your look has to hold together everywhere a shopper meets you: on pack, on your site and on social. We build one consistent set of brand codes for all three. We don't design the packaging itself, but your packaging designer gets the brand system to work from.
IND-BEAUTY-CODES-H2: What makes a skincare brand identity distinctive?
IND-BEAUTY-CODES-A: A small set of brand codes customers recognise before they read your name: a colour, a shape, a phrase or a way of photographing your product. To our eye most skincare feeds look alike, so the job is to pick codes your competitors don't use, then repeat them everywhere, consistently, for years.
IND-BEAUTY-CODES-BODY: That's why we start with the category, not the logo. We map the colours, claims and clichés everyone in skincare already uses, then look for the gaps. A colour nobody owns. A way of talking that sounds like a person, not a lab. A product shot people can spot at thumbnail size.
IND-BEAUTY-MARKET-H2: How do you market a new skincare brand?
IND-BEAUTY-MARKET-A: Start with what people should remember, not with ads. Fix your positioning and brand codes, build a site that explains each product plainly, then choose one or two channels your buyers already use, often paid social or organic social. Measure what works, keep the codes consistent and scale what earns attention.
IND-BEAUTY-MARKET-BODY: For skincare, those channels are often Meta, TikTok or both, with Google Search catching people who already know what they want. We pick channels after the audit, not before. And we keep product talk to what you can stand behind: no ingredient or efficacy claims from us.
IND-BEAUTY-CLAIMS-NOTE: Product and ad claims follow each platform's and each market's advertising rules. This isn't legal, regulatory or medical advice.
IND-BEAUTY-FOUND-H2: Getting skincare brands found in search and AI answers
IND-BEAUTY-FOUND-A: Make it easy for search engines and AI tools to understand you. Publish clear pages that answer the questions shoppers ask and keep your brand facts identical everywhere. Earn mentions on sites AI tools already trust, such as editorial roundups and genuine reviews. Then check regularly what AI assistants say about your category.
IND-BEAUTY-FOUND-BODY: Nobody controls Google's results or what AI assistants say, so we don't promise rankings or mentions. What we can do is fix what's holding your site back and make your brand clear enough that search engines and AI tools have good reason to show it.
IND-BEAUTY-SOCIAL-H2: Social for skincare: rhythm over volume
IND-BEAUTY-SOCIAL-A: Post fewer, better pieces in a voice people recognise, on a rhythm your team can keep. Every post should carry your brand codes, so a viewer knows it's you before the caption. We think short video often suits beauty, on Instagram, TikTok or both, but consistency matters more than volume. Nothing goes out without your approval.
IND-BEAUTY-KIT-H2: Which kit fits a skincare brand?
IND-BEAUTY-KIT-1: Launching or relaunching? The Launch Kit is best for new or relaunching brands that need to look right and get moving: a brand identity, a website or landing page and a 30 to 60 day performance or social sprint.
IND-BEAUTY-KIT-2: Already selling but hard to find? The Authority Kit is best for brands that want to be the name search engines and AI answers trust: positioning and site structure, SEO/AEO/GEO and a content engine.
IND-BEAUTY-KIT-3: Only need one thing? Take any service on its own. Full package or à la carte, it all runs on the same brand codes.
IND-BEAUTY-FAQ-1-Q: Do you only work with skincare brands?
IND-BEAUTY-FAQ-1-A: No. UK DTC beauty and skincare is a big focus because brands there blur fast, but the fundamentals travel. The same work suits clinics, trades, studios, gyms, hospitality, education and property. If people need to remember you, this work is for you.
IND-BEAUTY-FAQ-2-Q: Can you help a skincare brand that's about to launch?
IND-BEAUTY-FAQ-2-A: Yes. That's what the Launch Kit is for: a brand identity, a website or landing page and a 30 to 60 day performance or social sprint, all built on the same brand codes. It suits new or relaunching brands that need to look right and get moving.
IND-BEAUTY-FAQ-3-Q: Can you get our brand recommended by ChatGPT?
IND-BEAUTY-FAQ-3-A: Nobody can promise that, and you should be wary of anyone who does. What we can do is make your brand facts clear and consistent, build pages that answer the questions shoppers really ask and help you earn a presence on the sites AI tools already trust.
IND-BEAUTY-FAQ-4-Q: Do you work with beauty brands in Australia, Canada or Singapore?
IND-BEAUTY-FAQ-4-A: Yes. We work with SMB founders and marketing leads right across the UK, Australia, Canada and Singapore. The work happens remotely, with calls always planned around your own time zone. We write in British English unless your market needs something else.
IND-BEAUTY-FAQ-5-A: No. Packaging and on-shelf design aren't part of our branding service. What we do is keep your brand look consistent across pack, site and social. We can hand your packaging designer the brand system, so the pack, your feed and your ads all feel like one brand.
IND-BEAUTY-FAQ-6-Q: Do you set up or run TikTok Shop?
IND-BEAUTY-FAQ-6-A: No. We don't set up or manage TikTok Shop. We do use TikTok as a social and ads channel where your buyers spend time, with creative built on your brand codes. Every post gets your approval before it goes out, and your ad accounts stay in your name.
